answer:
I rebuilt the Meal plan page so it fits an iPhone screen with no sideways scrolling. The old page used a fixed 900px-wide table, which is why it ran off the screen.

Each day now has its own card. The card shows Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner and Snack as rows, and any Notes underneath. Days where Shop is "Yes" get a small "Shop" tag. The page uses the app's colours, so dark mode works. I haven't opened it on a phone myself.

The note's table is unchanged. The old page version is kept in the page history if you want it back.
